description: OPTIONS request MUST return Allow header listing supported methods.
TRACE request MUST be rejected with 405 Method Not Allowed to prevent XST.
Accept-Encoding negotiation MUST honor q-values and reject encodings with q=0.
If-Match MUST use strong comparison and return 412 Precondition Failed on mismatch.
If-None-Match MUST use weak comparison and return 304 Not Modified for GET/HEAD when matched.
Recipient MUST ignore If-Modified-Since when If-None-Match is present in the request.
Preconditions MUST be evaluated in strict order: If-Match, If-Unmodified-Since, If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since.
Satisfiable byte-range requests MUST return 206 Partial Content with Content-Range header and exact slice.
Unsatisfiable Range requests MUST return 416 Range Not Satisfiable with Content-Range: bytes */length.
If-Range MUST serve 206 Partial Content when validator matches and full 200 OK when validator mismatches.
Output Cache MUST store cacheable 200 OK responses and emit Age header on subsequent hits.
Request Cache-Control: no-cache or no-store MUST bypass cached responses.
Unsafe methods (POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH) MUST invalidate cached entries for the target URI.
Output Cache MUST partition cached representations by negotiated Content-Encoding (Vary: Accept-Encoding).
Server MUST respond with 400 Bad Request to any HTTP/1.1 request lacking a Host header or containing multiple/invalid Host headers.
HTTP/2 requests using :authority pseudo-header without legacy Host header MUST route accurately.
WebSocket upgrade requests MUST complete 101 Switching Protocols handshake and exchange bi-directional frames.
Brotli (br) compressed responses MUST decompress accurately and set Content-Encoding: br.
Zstandard (zstd) responses MUST start with RFC 8878 frame magic number 0xFD2FB528 and set Content-Encoding: zstd.
Gzip responses MUST start with RFC 1952 ID1/ID2 magic bytes (0x1F 0x8B) and decompress accurately.
SNI hostname selector MUST route TLS handshakes to the matching site binding and certificate.
Sites with HSTS enabled MUST emit valid Strict-Transport-Security header.
Reverse proxy and IPC dispatchers MUST append RFC 7239 Forwarded (for, proto, host) header.
Error responses MUST emit RFC 9457 application/problem+json containing type, title, status, detail, and instance.
HTTPS responses over HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2 MUST advertise HTTP/3 availability via Alt-Svc when HTTP/3 transport is enabled.
Dynamic endpoints configured with EarlyHintsLinks MUST emit preload Link headers and trigger interim 103 Early Hints dispatch.
Rate-limited requests exceeding quota MUST return 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After header.
Requests to /.well-known/acme-challenge/{token} MUST respond 200 text/plain with the matching key authorization string.
Sites configured with RedirectHttpToHttps MUST return HTTP 308/301 Location pointing to https:// while preserving host, path, and query string.
gRPC-Web bridge MUST encode trailing gRPC headers into a 0x80 uncompressed trailer frame with 4-byte big-endian length prefix.
L4 TLS passthrough proxy MUST inspect ClientHello SNI extension (0x0000) without terminating TLS.
Bounded request body WAF MUST reject JSON payloads exceeding MaxJsonDepth with HTTP 400 and rewind valid streams.
Gateway routes configured with chaos fault injection MUST return the configured 5xx ProblemDetails response and support declarative path/header transforms.
